en.title: 3. Verifiable (text-to-query, not text-to-answer)
en.description: FDAI flow for 3. Verifiable (text-to-query, not text-to-answer).
en.alt: 3. Verifiable (text-to-query, not text-to-answer). The main stages are NL question, model: compile / NL to typed ontology query, verifier: query is / well-typed and read-only, T0: execute query / over the twin (deterministic), Assurance Twin / ontology graph, grounded result set, model: explain / result + cite rule path, answer + provenance / + confidence + what-if, abstain: 'not known'.
